misprints.note: Dative without iota subscript in print (δρόμῳ on the same line has it).
Breathing printed on epsilon instead of iota.
No rough breathing visible on rho; also no comma before τό.
Full stop after d missing in print.

uncertain.note: An iota subscript may be missing because of faint ink rather than a misprint. None is visible.
The rho breathing may be faint or broken rather than missing.
The mark over ι reads as rough breathing alone. It could also be rough breathing with an acute (αἵ).
The question mark has a damaged or odd extra mark before it in the print.
The lone 'i,' is copied as printed. It may be a printing slip.
